page_title: CAG 1-2 FIO | Cagliari v Fiorentina 23/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+7' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
90+7' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina). Livio Marinelli saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick.
90+6' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Livio Marinelli had an easy-decision to make.
90+5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina).

90+4' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Elia Caprile is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fiorentina.
90+3' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+3' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) is able to continue to play.
87' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
86' Substitution. Lucas Beltran did his best and is replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina).
85' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
84' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina).
84' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 13:12.
81' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) replacing Rolando Mandragora.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) will replace Luca Ranieri.
79' This is a yellow card! Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
79' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
78' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle and signals a foul after Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) brought his opponent down. Cagliari will take a free kick.
76' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David de Gea intercepts the ball.

75' David de Gea dives superbly and makes a brilliant save to deny a first-time long-range effort towards the bottom right corner. Razvan Marin (Cagliari) was the player who tested the keeper's reflexes. Nice goalkeeping skills.
74' The game is interrupted now, Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' 5:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 1:3.
69' Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nadir Zortea departs the field of play to be replaced by Florinel Coman (Cagliari).
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Razvan Marin (Cagliari) is coming onto the pitch as Michel Adopo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Here is a change. Matteo Prati is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari).
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare. Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
63' Substitution. Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) replaces Nicolo Fagioli.
62' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Robin Gosens and he is replaced by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina).

62' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment. Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) jumps into a tackle and Livio Marinelli signals a foul.
61' Fiorentina are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
59' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) replaces Nicolas Viola.
57' A long pass, executed by Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
56' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
55' Dodo (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Elia Caprile, who smothers the ball.
54' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
52' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
51' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) sends a long ball forward to Nadir Zortea, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.

48' 1 - 2 Goal! Dodo clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the top of the net. Elia Caprile had no chance of stopping that. 1:2.
46' Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) sends a long cross over to Roberto Piccoli, but David de Gea comes forward to gather the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Livio Marinelli has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' The Cagliari players are stunned as referee Livio Marinelli changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Cagliari, he's going to review using VAR.

44' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Livio Marinelli stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A penalty is given to Cagliari!
42' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends a long cross over to Albert Gudmundsson, but Elia Caprile comes forward to gather the ball.
41' Problems for Davide Nicola as Yerry Mina is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) replaces him.
39' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

36' 1 - 1 Goal! Rolando Mandragora displays great vision and sends a pass to Robin Gosens (Fiorentina), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.
34' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
33' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina), but the defence gets it clear.
31' PENALTY APPEAL after Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
30' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) tries to find Zito Luvumbo, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
28' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.

27' Nice individual effort by Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina). He gets all the way to the goalkeeper, produces a strike towards the right side of the target, but Elia Caprile does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out with a save. Dodo (Fiorentina) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
26' The total number of attempts is 5:2. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:0.
26' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) offside.
21' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
20' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Fiorentina have a corner.
20' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
20' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) takes the corner with a short pass.
19' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but David de Gea comes off his line to gather the ball.
17' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. It's a throw-in for Cagliari.
16' The game is interrupted now, Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
15' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball hits the right post.
14' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle after Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Fiorentina have a free kick from a promising distance.
12' The corner from Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is hurriedly cleared.
12' OFF THE POST! Good play from Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the left post!
12' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

11' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Cagliari force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
10' The referee blows his whistle as Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) was too aggressive in his challenge.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
7' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) serves up a nice cross, but David de Gea punches the ball away.
6' The foul by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) was seen by Livio Marinelli who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
5' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) sent a pass onto Roberto Piccoli, who didn't get a chance to finish.
3' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) launches a cross from the corner, but David de Gea is alert to thwart the effort.
3' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Cagliari will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
